en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a powerful river rapid or waterfall rushing through a rocky gorge lined with dense trees. On the left bank stands a multi‑storey light‑colored building close to the turbulent water. In the distance the river drops further under a pastel sunset sky. Handwritten cursive text is visible along the bottom margin, with faint printed captions beneath the image.
